name: Nails by Magaly

address.note: Booksy's JSON-LD lists addressLocality as 'Hollywood, FL' (booking-area label / listing category), but the streetAddress and postal code (33025) place it in Pembroke Pines, matching the original lead. Geo: 25.9959782, -80.2811219.

email_search_notes: Deep search performed per PIPELINE.md fase 1 punto 7: Booksy JSON-LD/venue payload (no email/phone field populated), Instagram web_profile_info endpoint (returns HTTP 400, confirmed broken per FORGE-BRIEF), IG bio via web fetch (blocked, HTTP 429), Facebook page facebook.com/p/Nails-by-Magaly-100079881833363 About section (login-walled, inaccessible), general web search for phone/email (no results). No public email or phone number found. This appears to be a solo, appointment-only home/private studio (limited hours, no Google Business listing found, no published phone).

other_platforms_checked.square_site: https://nails-by-magaly.square.site/ (exists, appointments page, no menu/contact data extracted beyond booking widget; Booksy used as primary source per its richer JSON-LD dossier)
other_platforms_checked.facebook: facebook.com/p/Nails-by-Magaly-100079881833363/ found via search (likely real page, login-walled, could not extract). Note: facebook.com/nailsbymagaly redirects to an UNRELATED business ('Nail Design By Magaly', Pecos TX) - not this business, discarded.

has_own_site_check: Tried nailsbymagaly.com, nailsbymagalynails.com, nails-by-magaly.com via curl: all failed DNS resolution (no domain registered). Web search for '"Nails by Magaly" Pembroke Pines website nailsbymagaly.com' returned no owned-domain result, only Booksy, Instagram, Facebook and the nails-by-magaly.square.site booking subdomain. Square.site subdomain does NOT count as an own website per pipeline rules. Booksy website_candidates field was empty. Conclusion: no owned website, has_own_site = false.
rating_source: Booksy listing (booksy_dossier.py extraction from JSON-LD aggregateRating). Independent Google listing not found in web search (business likely has no standalone Google Business Profile, consistent with a solo appointment-only studio); rating NOT independently cross-verified against Google, Booksy is the sole confirmed source.
language_notes: Determined by booksy_dossier.py heuristic over the review text (mix of Spanish and English reviews, business owner communicates in Spanish per review content e.g. Julietta L.'s review). Site built with Spanish as default language, English available via toggle.
brand_vibe: Feminine rose-gold blush boutique. Real branding evidence: physical branded photo mat/coaster used in nearly every promotional photo reads 'Nails by Magaly' in rose-gold metallic script over white, with 'TRAZO' beneath it, and a partial slogan fragment visible across multiple photos ('...NCIA EN...' + 'TRAZO') consistent with 'Confianza en cada trazo' (used as the site's tagline, verified by cross-referencing the same fragment across bk-7/bk-8/bk-10 raw photos). Palette chosen: deep rose/berry accent-deep #b5486a + rose-gold copper accent-mid #cf8f68 on a warm blush-cream base #fdf3f0, echoing the real logo's rose-gold color and the salon's frequent hot-pink/magenta gel work.
services_source: output/nailsbymagaly's Booksy JSON-LD via scripts/booksy_dossier.py, all 14 services listed on the site (grouped into 4 featured cards: Manicure, Extensiones/Full Set Acrílico [featured], Pedicure, Diseños & Extras), no service omitted or invented.

reviews.author: Julietta L.
reviews.body: Ustedes no la pueden comparar con ninguna, porque ella es la mejor, pone todo su empeño para dejarte preciosa, cuida y consiente tus uñas, te escucha y te hace reír. Soy una clienta desde que ella empezó y he visto como ha crecido, como aprende todos los días para hacernos ver espectacular. Si van donde ella, difícilmente volverán a otros lugares, porque te casas con Nails by Magaly!!!!

reviews.author: Shama D.
reviews.body: Super affordable. And absolutely more than worth it. She takes her time and makes you look and feel good. Magaly is sweet and attentive. Very professional and caring about her clients. Pats close attention to detail and my nails always last so long! I work a lot with my hands.

reviews.author: Roset
reviews.body: Magali is simply the best!!!! Love her job and love my nails.

reviews.author: Ivania
reviews.body: Love my nails! Exactly what I asked for.
Me encanto el trabajo de mis uñas la atención y me sentí como en casa mis felicitaciones excelente trabajo quede muy satisfecha Graciassss
